01 · Reserve online, pick up in Miami

Check out once. Collect it when we say it’s ready.

Every listing on the store can be collected at the showroom. Add it to the bag, and at checkout choose Pick up at our Miami showroom instead of a carrier. Shipping is then free; the address fields give way to the showroom’s address.

We tell you when your order is ready to collect. Most listings ship to us from the warehouse, so “ready” depends on the item; listings that are on the showroom floor will say Pick up today once the store shows stock by location.

Sales tax still applies on a pickup: Florida’s 6% plus Miami-Dade’s 1% surtax, worked out by the store at checkout. Churches, other religious institutions and resellers with an approved exemption certificate pay none. How tax-exempt purchasing works.

Showroom questions.

Address, hours, pickup, tax and returns.

Where is the i9Store showroom?

At 20815 NE 16th Ave, STE B33, Miami, FL 33179. It is the address of I9Store USA LLC, the company that sells on i9store.com/usa.

What are the showroom hours?

Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Miami time. Holiday hours can differ, so confirm before you come.

Can I order online and pick up in Miami?

Yes. At checkout choose “Pick up at our Miami showroom”. Pickup is free, and the store tells you when the order is ready to collect.

Is sales tax charged on a pickup order?

Yes. A pickup in Miami pays Florida sales tax (6%) plus the Miami-Dade surtax (1%), unless your organization is tax-exempt and its certificate is approved. Resellers and religious institutions can buy without sales tax with a valid certificate.

Can I return an item at the showroom?

Returns follow the store policy: 30 days from delivery or pickup, with an extended holiday window for purchases made from November 1 to January 1. Items that cannot be resold as new carry a restocking fee of at least 15%.

Can I see a product before I buy it?

Book a visit and tell us what you want to see. The team confirms what is at the showroom for your day, or what can be brought in.
